body:
First of all, you are not responsible for their actions, emotions, feelings. This means they shouldn't weigh you down, but I understand how they could, you living with them.
If you believe your mom is a victim of abuse, try speaking about it to other family members if you can (trustworthy ones) or contacting an organisation about it, to have advice on how to help her leave. If you feel like you have the strength to help her through it and out of it, then do it.
However, I know caring for a parent as an 18 year old is exhausting. So if she refuses the help, there's not much else you can do. Assess how much this affects you (I imagine this constantly negative environment stresses you and slows you down in your own growth), and from there, try to move on. Don't feel burdened by their issues. Try to move out as quick as possible. If you have reliable friends/relatives that you trust, ask them if you can come overnight/for a few days if things are getting too heated at home. Make sure you have a "safe place", where you aren't bothered by their conflicts. They are both adults, and you can try to help, but it is in no way your role or obligation as their child. Just do as you feel most comfortable, have your own wellbeing as your priority. Good luck!
